reviewer: CORE independent reviewer (formerly device_return_review; no production writes)
findingBasis: Web Media operator== compares URI; any(media != current) is false exactly for the all-equal URI case with a valid current element. No rejection-sampling loop is entered for that case or a singleton.

Current index and exact Media object order remain unchanged on all-equal enable and restore. IdentityEquality checks order/occurrence identity, while published playlist equality remains its existing URI/index semantics.
Ordinary queues with more than one equality class retain the existing rejection sampling and indexOf(current) path. No claim fixes mixed duplicate occurrence tracking or queue edits during shuffle.
Copy-on-write previous snapshot protection remains unchanged.

Two new Web-only tests construct distinct Media objects sharing URI or repeat one Media object, start at index2, run true,true,false,false twice, inspect exact per-position identity/current index/retained snapshot and collect playlist/mode events.
Each toList listener is attached before open and awaited after the finally dispose closes the streams; no unawaited expectation is introduced by the delta.
collection import already exists; typed const ListEquality<Media>(IdentityEquality<Media>()) matches the official constructor contracts. No dependency or global equality change.

validation.notRunOnOldCode: The old all-equal while loop is synchronous; running the regression against it would block the JS event loop and defeat a timer-based test timeout. No executed red-test claim.
requiredHosted: six targeted shuffle cases on actual reviewed/new source combination
full Web package suite on same source/merge vector
